description: How an SDK turns an error response into its typed error hierarchy. The class of a code comes from its catalog family: auth -> auth, quota -> rate_limit, idempotency -> idempotency, platform -> server; every other family is validation, unless its status is 5xx (server). A code the SDK does not know is classed by its status (fallback). retryable is the problem's own member; without a problem body it comes from the status defaults, and a status outside the table is not retryable. catalog and status_defaults are copies of contracts/errors.yaml and are checked against it.
